text:
mira: Ops wants to sweep `prefix_cache_ttl` 30->300 to cut KV churn. Need safe rollout + console visibility. Any blockers?

alex: Main risk is per-shard memory bump and GC/eviction behavior. Need mem delta estimate and p99 impact.

jess: Console would like to mark this as a sweep so UX differs from targeted flags. Request optional `rollout_type` on apply API.

tyler: We already have `purpose`. Adding fields ok but try to keep API small and backward-compatible.

sam: Suggested rollout: staging replay 24h, then 1% tenant cohort 2h, 10% 6h, full sweep. Gates: >=5k sampled reqs, <2% quota_rejects increase, <5% per-shard mem increase, p99 latency delta <10ms.

ops-bot: Alert `prefix-cache-mem-80pct` created (ACL-3742).

alex: Need a console panel with per-tenant cache size + delta for triage. Console only shows global mem today.

jess: I can build the panel once API exposes per-tenant mem and optional fields. Propose `rollout_type` enum ["targeted","sweep","dry-run"] plus `previous_version` and `applied_by` optional fields.

mira: Also want fast revert. Either `rollback_token` or use `config_version` bump and keep previous for 10m so revert is setting version back.

tyler: Prefer `config_version` approach to avoid new tokens; smaller surface.

sam: Telemetry: wait 30m warm window before evaluating deltas to avoid transients; require min samples. I'll post PromQL drafts after replay.

alex: Ops playbook dry-run example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/configs/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"config_key":"prefix_cache_ttl","value":300,"dry_run":true,"meta":{"rollout_type":"dry-run","operator":"mira"}}'
```

jess: Console will flag dry-run entries orange with hover "no traffic change - dry run"; sweeps get a different badge and runbook link.

mira: Actions: sam runs staging replay and posts mem estimates by EOD; jess opens API extension PR; alex+tyler prototype per-tenant mem panel; ops wire alert into canary step.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/prefix-cache-sweep

sam: Draft PromQL for eviction delta: `increase(prefix_cache_evictions_total[5m]) / increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])` filtered by cohort labels; will refine after replay.

alex: If staging looks good, start 1% cohort tomorrow morning.

mira: Thanks — ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
